meta.title: Flocksy — AI Farm Intelligence for Indian Farmers
meta.description: Manage your poultry, dairy, livestock and crops with AI. Disease detection, weather, markets, schemes and expert advice — all in one simple app.

landing.farmTypesTitle: One app for every kind of farming
landing.testimonial1: A hen was sick and I didn't know why. I took a photo and Flocksy told me in Hindi what to do. It saved my whole batch.
landing.testimonial2: I'm not comfortable with phones, but the big buttons and voice make it easy. My daughter set it up in five minutes.
landing.testimonial3: We compare market rates every morning now. We earn ₹40,000 more per year selling at the right time.
landing.faq1Q: Do I need to be good with phones?
landing.faq1A: No. Flocksy uses large buttons, clear icons and voice support in Hindi and English. Most farmers set it up in minutes with help from family.
landing.faq2A: Yes. Your farm records and key tools work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.
landing.faq3A: Our AI is trained on Indian poultry and livestock conditions and is continuously verified by veterinarians. Always confirm critical cases with a vet.
landing.faq4A: Yes. Your data is encrypted, never sold, and you can delete it anytime.
landing.faq5A: The app is free to start. Premium plans cost less than a cup of chai a day and help us keep improving.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to grow a healthier farm?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of farmers using AI to protect their animals and earn more. Free to start, no credit card needed.
landing.footerDesc: AI-powered farm intelligence for every Indian farmer.
landing.demoSubtitle: Send a photo or just ask in Hindi. Flocksy reads the symptoms, ranks the likely diseases and tells you what to do today.
landing.demoTry: Want to try it with your own flock?
landing.stepsIntro: Every diagnosis carries a confidence score and a safety check — Flocksy does the reading, a vet keeps the final word.
landing.howStep2Bullet1: Chat, talk, or send a photo
landing.safetyBody: Flocksy never prescribes on its own. Every recommendation passes a safety gate that checks dosage, bird age and withdrawal periods before a farmer ever sees it.
landing.safetyPoint1: A vet reviews the serious cases
landing.safetyPoint1Desc: High-mortality events are escalated to a qualified veterinarian instead of being answered by AI alone.
landing.safetyPoint2: Unsafe medicine is blocked, not suggested
landing.safetyPoint2Desc: If a treatment fails an age or withdrawal-period check, Flocksy withholds it and explains why.
landing.impactBody: Farmers reach a confident answer in minutes instead of waiting days for a vet visit — catching outbreaks while they are still small.
landing.impactStatLabel: faster than waiting for a farm visit
landing.footerTagline: Warm, dependable software built for Indian farms.
landing.problemTitle: Poultry farming is harder than it should be.
landing.problemBody: Disease spreads fast. Expertise is scarce. Decisions are made on instinct. The industry deserves better tools.
landing.problem1Desc: By the time symptoms are visible, an outbreak has already begun. Early detection can save an entire batch.
landing.problem2Desc: Expert advice is hours away — and often too late. Farmers need intelligence that works in real time, not the next day.
landing.problem3Desc: Flock records, feed logs, mortality data — all written by hand. None of it analyzed. None of it actionable.
landing.problem4Desc: Without live price data and demand signals, farmers sell at the wrong time and leave money on the table.
landing.showcaseTitle: Your farm intelligence, in your pocket.
landing.showcaseBody: Ask in Hindi or English. Upload a photo of a sick bird. Get a diagnosis, a recommendation, and a vet — in seconds.
landing.processStep1Desc: Log your flock, track daily health indicators, and let Flocksy watch for early warning signs automatically.
landing.processStep2Desc: AI trained on Indian poultry conditions reads your photos, symptoms, and environment to identify what is wrong.
landing.processStep3Desc: Get a ranked diagnosis with confidence score, verified against veterinary protocols before it reaches you.
landing.processStep4Desc: Clear instructions. A vet on call. And a record of every decision so your next flock starts smarter.
